source: Arcadis 2020, Section 4.2 VSD energy analysis (PDF p.13), Table 4 (p.14, stripped), Sections 6-7 findings and recommendations (p.15-17). Withheld. Confirmation: Green WIN phase 2 summary p.38-39 (Xylem pump and automation installed 2021, fixed speed; specific energy 52-81 -> 42 kWh/1000 m3, -36.8%).

items.engineers: Xylem CT3400/736 (about 610 l/s, 77.5% overall, 43.5 kWh/1000 m3 at design lift; ~800 l/s at minimum lift) is well matched to the system and the range of operating levels; IE3 motor not available for this model; CT3531 alternative is only marginally different, ask Xylem to confirm lowest whole-life cost.
leak_phrases: is well matched to the system and range of operating levels

items.engineers: VSD reduces specific energy only at low lift (33.3 -> 25.4 kWh/1000 m3 at 40 Hz, 571 l/s) and increases it at design lift (43.5 -> 44.8) due to drive losses; high Saône levels (>175 mNGF) occur only ~5% of the time and energy costs are low, so VSD capital cost would outweigh savings: continue with fixed speed drives.
leak_phrases: reduction in specific energy using VSDs at reduced speed

items.engineers: At 880,000 m3/yr: old pump 52.4 kWh/1000 m3 -> 46,112 kWh/yr; new pump 43.5 -> 38,280 kWh/yr; saving ~7,832 kWh/yr (~17%), a modest saving since running costs are low.
leak_phrases: The new pumps provide modest energy saving

items.engineers: For fixed speed drives, power factor correction is recommended (CT3400 PF ~0.8-0.82).
leak_phrases: For fixed speed drives power factor correction is recommended

items.engineers: Replace the DN700 riser section upstream of the DN600 flowmeter with DN600 (2.8 m/s at 800 l/s exceeds 2.2 m/s but <3 m/s is acceptable for short lengths; extra friction offset by removing the expansion taper and a reducer); move the valve down to the landing below to get 5D upstream / 2D downstream straight lengths for the flowmeter.
leak_phrases: 600 mm diameter pipe produces a velocity of 2.8 m/s

items.engineers: Install automated control based on downstream (and upstream) level monitoring, plus SCADA with performance metric reporting (pump power, flow) and possible smart control adjustment.
leak_phrases: Install SCADA system and introduce performance metric reporting
